title: Grace-period coordinator and ops decision log for RBAC v2 wave cutover
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Coordinate a controlled RBAC v1->v2 migration wave by introducing a lightweight 'grace-period coordinator' service and an operator-facing decision log. The coordinator centralizes customer opt-in windows, enforces safe backfill rate-limits, exposes automated gating metrics, and records every operator decision with rationale for post-mortem and audit. Scope includes: dual-write plumbing, backfill orchestration, SSO/SAML mapping verification, audit-log bridging, canary sampling, escalation/rollback triggers, and customer communications templates.
acceptance_criteria: Grace-period coordinator deployed in staging and can be toggled per org ID
Dual-write mode annotated in coordinator with per-org start/end timestamps
Backfill job supports rate-limits and resumability and exposes progress metrics (processed, failed, pending)
Telemetry gating: if key divergence > 0.5% or API error rate > 1% for 5m window, coordinator auto-pauses cutover and logs operator decision
Operator decision log persists to audit store and is queryable by compliance team
Customer opt-in flow and email templates validated with legal and growth; opt-in window configurable per wave
SSO/SAML mapping verification step completed for 100% of canary orgs before cutover
Rollback procedure exercised in dry-run and documented in operator playbook
rollout_steps: 1) Deploy coordinator to staging and enable for internal test orgs
2) Run synthetic canaries (100 synthetic users) to validate permission equivalence and audit parity
3) Start first wave: 50 low-risk customers with 48h opt-in window; dual-write enabled with backfill queued
4) Monitor telemetry gates for 72h, patch issues, record decisions; if gated, pause wave and open incident
5) Expand to subsequent waves (200 -> 1k -> full) with progressively shorter opt-in windows and higher automation
6) After full completion, schedule deprecation of v1 with 30d customer notice
operator_playbook: Pre-checks: confirm latest role-schema migration PR merged and migration job binary deployed
Before enabling dual-write: sample 50 random users and compare effective permissions between v1 and v2; threshold for pass: 100% match on role membership
If backfill fails with >0.1% unexpected role assignment changes, pause wave and escalate to SecEng
During cutover, use coordinator UI to mark opt-in window timestamps and to record an operator decision for each manual override
Rollback: trigger coordinator 'freeze' -> revert route to v1-only via routing policy -> run expedited reconciliation to clear partial writes
Post-rollback: open customer comms pipeline and a timeline for remediation and targeted backfill retry
monitoring_and_telemetry: Metrics to emit: backfill_progress.percent_complete, backfill_errors.per_minute, dualwrite_conflicts.count, role_delta.rate, audit_bridge_lag.seconds
Gating rules: role_delta.rate > 0.5% over 10m OR dualwrite_conflicts.count > 10 in 5m triggers auto-pause
Synthetic canaries: compare audit entries from v1 and v2 for identical events for a 24h rolling window
Alerting: PagerDuty if auto-pause occurs; Slack #rbac-migration with pager context and direct link to decision log
Long-term: retain decision-log snapshots and backfill diffs for 13 months for compliance audits
communication_plan: Customer-facing: staged opt-in emails + in-console banner with opt-in button and FAQ link
High-touch customers: Solutions sends tailored migration runbook; Security team signs-off on SSO mapping reports
Status page: publish wave start/stop times and anonymized health metrics during rollout
Internal: weekly migration sync with Eng/Product/Support/Legal; decision log exported to Confluence weekly
Escalation: predefined templates for 'paused', 'rolled back', 'completed' to be used by Support and Account Management
